She lovingly embraces a young blonde boy (R2) who sits in her lap looking forward. The older woman's hand rests gently on the boy's chest. In the foreground, a tall white candle burns brightly, while the background features a decorated Christmas tree with warm, glowing bokeh lights. Soft candlelight illuminates the foreground, creating a cozy and intimate holiday atmosphere.
